### Agenus to Participate in Rodman & Renshaw Virtual Fireside Chat


November 2, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/949764554/files/doc_news/Agenus-to-Participate-in-Rodman--Renshaw-Virtual-Fireside-Chat-2026.pdf)


LEXINGTON, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Agenus Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.agenusbio.com&esheet=54633923&newsitemid=20261102477263&lan=en-US&anchor=Agenus+Inc.&index=1&md5=19fb3fade317ee8ccd4e9c225efe94ce) **(Nasdaq: AGEN)** , a leader in immuno-oncology innovation, today announced that Robin Taylor, Chief Commercial Officer, and Zack Armen, Vice President of Corporate Development and Investor Relations, will participate in a virtual fireside chat hosted by Rodman & Renshaw on Thursday, November 5, 2026.


The discussion will be moderated by Michael G. King, Jr., Senior Biotechnology Analyst and will focus on the development of botensilimab (BOT) and balstilimab (BAL), including neoadjuvant colon cancer results from NEST, UNICORN and NEOASIS, and the planned Phase 3 ROBBIN trial. Management will also discuss strategic priorities, funding and the commercial opportunity for BOT+BAL.


**Rodman & Renshaw Virtual Fireside Chat**


**Date:** Thursday, November 5, 2026
**Time:** 11:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. ET
**Format:** Virtual
**Registration:**[Register here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fus06web.zoom.us%2Fwebinar%2Fregister%2FWN_uG1SMpSHToiXBEmfEuiw2w&esheet=54633923&newsitemid=20261102477263&lan=en-US&anchor=Register+here&index=2&md5=65b6f6790d5da5a759dcda902379ab84)


**About Agenus**


Agenus is a leading immuno-oncology company targeting cancer with a comprehensive pipeline of immunological agents. The company was founded in 1994 with a mission to expand patient populations benefiting from cancer immunotherapy through combination approaches, using a broad repertoire of antibody therapeutics, adoptive cell therapies (through MiNK Therapeutics) and adjuvants. Agenus has robust end-to-end development capabilities, across commercial and clinical cGMP manufacturing facilities, research and discovery, and a global clinical operations footprint. Agenus is headquartered in Lexington, MA. For more information, visit[www.agenusbio.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.agenusbio.com&esheet=54633923&newsitemid=20261102477263&lan=en-US&anchor=www.agenusbio.com&index=3&md5=e36f5877755d69bab3141460add7a4ff) or @agenus_bio. Information that may be important to investors will be routinely posted on our website and social media channels.
